---
title: "過去問一覧"
toc: false
page-layout: full
format:
  html:
    css: ../assets/css/problems-table.css
---

```{=html}
<div id="problem-table-app" class="problem-table-app" data-default-exam="primary">
  <nav class="exam-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="試験区分">
    <button
      id="exam-tab-primary"
      class="exam-tab"
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      aria-selected="true"
      aria-controls="problem-table-panel"
      data-exam="primary"
    >1次</button>
    <button
      id="exam-tab-secondary"
      class="exam-tab"
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      aria-selected="false"
      aria-controls="problem-table-panel"
      data-exam="secondary"
    >2次</button>
  </nav>

  <section
    id="problem-table-panel"
    class="problem-table-panel"
    role="tabpanel"
    aria-labelledby="exam-tab-primary"
  >
    <p id="problem-table-status" class="problem-table-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">
      過去問データを読み込んでいます…
    </p>
    <div id="problem-table-container"></div>
  </section>

  <noscript>
    <p class="problem-table-error">この一覧を表示するにはJavaScriptを有効にしてください。</p>
  </noscript>
</div>

<script type="module" src="../assets/js/problems-table.js"></script>
```
